name: System Packages
description: Installs system packages on various Linux distributions.

pkg.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on any distribution.

apt.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on Debian/Ubuntu (apt).

pacman.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on Arch Linux (pacman).

dnf.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on Fedora/RHEL/CentOS (dnf).

dnfGroup.description: Space-separated list of groups to install on Fedora/RHEL/CentOS (dnf). Use quotes for group names that contain spaces.

yum.description: Space-separated list of packages to install via yum.

emerge.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on Gentoo (emerge).

rpmOstree.description: Space-separated list of packages to install via rpm-ostree.

zypper.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on openSUSE (zypper).

zypperPattern.description: Space-separated list of patterns to install on openSUSE (zypper). Use quotes for pattern names that contain spaces.

apk.description: Space-separated list of packages to install on Alpine Linux (apk).
